instructions_to_main_agent: Build a world-class personal portfolio website for Rohan Lodaya modeled on landoiris.com style with Lenis smooth scrolling, GSAP ScrollTrigger animations, kinetic oversized hero with masked line reveal, custom cursor, editorial marquee, bento experience and projects showcase, interactive contact and resume download, and a stunning 3D/parallax matte black sports bike hero visual. Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } prohibited).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
